page_title: RBL 0-0 MON | RB Leipzig v B. Monchengladbach 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lukas Ullrich walks off the pitch to be replaced by Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach).
89' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
86' 59:41 – the ratio of ball possession.
84' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
84' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
81' Substitution. Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) makes his way off the pitch and Tomas Cvancara comes on as his replacement.
81' Substitution. Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is replaced by Nathan Ngoumou.
81' Here is a change. Christoph Baumgartner is going off and Marco Rose gives the last tactical orders to Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig).
81' It's time for a substitution. Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) comes on in place of Arthur Vermeeren.

79' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
77' The total number of attempts is 9:14.
75' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) serves up a nice cross, but Moritz Nicolas punches the ball away.
73' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) jumps into a tackle and Christian Dingert signals a foul.
73' Substitution. Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) on for Alassane Plea.
72' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Rocco Reitz and he is replaced by Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach).

71' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
70' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
68' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) replaces Benjamin Henrichs.
67' Yussuf Poulsen will be replaced by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig).
66' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
65' RB Leipzig work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
64' Great save! Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Moritz Nicolas.

61' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles of the left post. Nice run, but poor finish! The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
61' Christian Dingert blows his whistle and it's Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
59' B. Monchengladbach seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
56' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
55' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
55' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and RB Leipzig will take a corner.

54' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. RB Leipzig force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig) has tested the patience of referee Christian Dingert and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
51' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
50' The ball is cleared after Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
48' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Christian Dingert has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' RB Leipzig quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
45+1' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' It seemed like Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
44' Christian Dingert shows a yellow card to Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) for his blatant foul.

43' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) received a precise low pass and immediately unleashed a shot on goal. His attempt lacked a few centimetres to make it home as it crashed against the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
41' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Christian Dingert had an easy-decision to make.
41' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for B. Monchengladbach.
38' The cross into the penalty area from Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
36' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

35' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes. The ball goes out for a corner. RB Leipzig can continue in their attacking effort.
33' B. Monchengladbach are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
31' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

30' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. Nice run, but poor finish! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.

28' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig will have a throw-in.
27' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
24' Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
24' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner.

22' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
21' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
19' 1:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
16' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.

14' RB Leipzig slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
12' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball has crossed the sideline. B. Monchengladbach are taking a throw-in.
9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from B. Monchengladbach comes to nothing.
7' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
5' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The linesman signals a throw-in for RB Leipzig.
1' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
B. Monchengladbach will kick the game off.
